You have been given $100 to split between yourself and another entity.
You must propose how much of this $100 to give to the entity.
The entity will then choose to either accept or reject your proposal.
If they accept, you keep $100 minus your offer, and they receive your offered amount.
If they reject, both of you receive nothing.
Please tell me how much of the $100 you want to offer to the other entity (must be an integer between 0 and 100, inclusive), and explain your reasoning.

Your response must be in the following JSON format:
{
 "reasoning": "<your reasoning here>",
 "amount": "<amount as an integer>"
}

Make sure the "amount" value is just a number (no units, no extra text).
